 Former Dynata Chief Laben to Lead Acxiom
 November 17 2026 
Former Dynata CEO Gary Laben has joined Acxiom, the connected data and identity specialist within ad giant Omnicom, as its new Chief Exec. He succeeds Jarrod Martin, who will focus on his role as Chief Transformation Officer at Omnicom Media.
 Acxiom unifies, connects and prepares data for AI-driven marketing and decision-making. At the core of this is its Real ID solution, which provides Omni, Omnicom's marketing and sales intelligence platform, with a persistent identity foundation spanning 2.6 billion verified global identities. Acxiom became a part of Omnicom with the latter's $13.25 billion acquisition of IPG in December 2024 .
Laben (pictured) brings three decades of global experience in information services and technology, of which the past two and a half years were spent at AI-powered retail intelligence company Trax . He took charge of Research Now in 2016, steered its merger with SSI eighteen months later, and led the merged firm, soon renamed Dynata, until 2023, tripling its revenue and building the company to 5,500 employees spanning more than 40 countries. Earlier he was Global Chief Data Officer at Wunderman and CEO of global marketing services firm KBM Group , after working at Experian, TRW, and Dun & Bradstreet.
His new role includes leading the firm in its mission to accelerate how brands 'architect and activate' secure data ecosystems across global regulated industries, as well as driving development of its role in powering Omni.
Omnicom CEO and Chairman John Wren comments: 'Gary has spent his career building and transforming global data, identity and technology businesses, making him the right person to build on Acxiom's already strong capabilities.'
Web sites: acxiom.com and www.omc.com .
